detectors.description: lookalike dust transfers that follow a large transfer, aimed at a later copy-paste
cheapest venue to borrow each asset, capped by the liquidity actually withdrawable there
mass dust fan-out inside EIP-7702 / executeBatch calldata, from senders that mimic the recipient's counterparties
dollar supply rates ranked against the risk-free dollar, sized from each reserve’s own rate curve
Pendle implied fixed yields against the floating rate on the same underlying, sized by PT depth
base-fee spikes attributed to the contract whose gas demand caused them
tokens whose buyers cannot sell: reverting sales, confiscatory taxes, buyers without sellers
fee share taken by liquidity minted for a single swap, per pool and per window
lending reserves whose withdrawable liquidity collapses, and the time of day it happens
concentrated-LP fee yield net of divergence, at the band that stayed in range and at real size
one sender fanning a token out to thousands of recipients: airdrop, mint distribution or dust spam
address labels the window contradicts, which is how a headline moves by a multiple
redeemable claims trading away from the value the protocol pays, with the queue that separates them
cross-venue supply-rate gaps on one asset, de-spiked and sized by rate dilution
large same-transaction, same-pool v2-style swaps with nearly closed token positions
unlabelled contracts that pass value straight through: solvers, routers and searcher bots

hits.title: 0x7db113ecd5: 28 buyers, 5 sellers, 64% of 11 sell attempts emitted no logs — sales fail or are taxed, but sellers do exist — a gate on some holders, or a thin pool

evidence.verdict: sales fail or are taxed, but sellers do exist — a gate on some holders, or a thin pool
evidence.why: a transaction that emitted no logs reverted or did nothing, and a sell gate is what produces reverts; the buyer/seller ratio alone is the shape of any fresh launch, so it is never the finding on its own
evidence.false_positives: a thin pool reverting on slippage, an anti-sniper cooldown in a token’s first minutes, and calldata that names several tokens so a failure is attributed to all of them. Confirm by reading the contract or simulating a sale before treating this as a verdict.

hits.title: 0x33e8f27903: 37 buyers, 2 sellers — buyers far outnumber sellers and sales were attempted, but none is shown to fail

evidence.verdict: buyers far outnumber sellers and sales were attempted, but none is shown to fail
evidence.why: a transaction that emitted no logs reverted or did nothing, and a sell gate is what produces reverts; the buyer/seller ratio alone is the shape of any fresh launch, so it is never the finding on its own
evidence.false_positives: a thin pool reverting on slippage, an anti-sniper cooldown in a token’s first minutes, and calldata that names several tokens so a failure is attributed to all of them. Confirm by reading the contract or simulating a sale before treating this as a verdict.
